target_customer: Last-mile delivery and fleet companies that need dispatch and route optimization as an API
problem: Last-mile operators need fast route and dispatch algorithms to offer same-day and next-hour delivery profitably.
product_category: Route optimization and fleet dispatch API

founders.name: Yuzhe Yan
founders.background_notes: Self-described algorithms expert and C++ developer on YC page

founders.name: Tiangang Song
founders.background_notes: Self-described tech geek on YC page

technical_complexity.rationale: Vehicle routing with real-time dispatch at scale is a hard optimization problem; the founders claim 30X faster algorithms (unverified).

defensibility.rationale: Algorithm quality could be a moat, but routing APIs from several vendors existed and performance claims are unverified.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copy sourced; company still listed active.

market_need_then: Growth in same-day and last-mile delivery in 2020 and 2021; no direct spend evidence found.

identity.logo: Stylized L per a directory listing

brand_strength.rationale: Generic name, no press about the brand; a USPTO trademark exists (filed 2021-09, registered 2022-11).

outcome_analysis: LogisticsOS is an active small route optimization API company from YC Winter 2021. The founders claim FedEx and USPS use its engine in production, which is unverified. Funding is reported at about 130 thousand dollars by one database and no larger round is confirmed, so the story is a capital light technical team with unknown traction and no clear success or failure signal.
notes: Funding figures conflict: CB Insights about $130K seed in 2021-02 led by Liquid 2 Ventures with Y Combinator and Hack VC; one other source claims $500K to $625K. All aggregator figures, unverified, so no round recorded. Revenue claim of $1.7M in 2024 is from a third-party profile and unverified. FedEx and USPS claim is company marketing only. The official website was not fetched in this run beyond the YC page. No dated competitor source near the batch, list empty.
